faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.lead: Quick answers about studying, treatment, and travel in Türkiye — and how your case works.

items.a1: We coordinate three connected services in Türkiye: university admissions, medical consultation and treatment planning, and travel around your appointments. Everything runs through a single case handled by one team.
items.q2: Is my personal and medical information safe?
items.a2: Yes. Identity and medical documents are stored in private storage and are only accessible to the team members assigned to your case. We never sell your data.
items.q3: Do I need an account to get started?
items.a3: An account lets you open a case and follow its progress. You can create one in a minute; it keeps your documents and messages in one private place.
items.a4: Once your case is reviewed, you receive a written quotation with the exact amounts. Quotations are fixed snapshots, so the price you are shown is the price that applies to that offer.
items.a5: The platform is available in English, Turkish, French, and Arabic. You can switch languages at any time from the top of the page.
items.q6: How do I contact the team?
items.a6: Use the contact page to reach us, or sign in to your case to send a message directly to the team handling it.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.lead: How medbourse collects, uses, and protects your information.

dataWeCollect.title: Information we collect
dataWeCollect.body: We collect the information you provide when you create an account or open a case — such as your name, contact details, and the documents you upload. We also record technical information needed to operate the service securely.

howWeUse.title: How we use your information
howWeUse.body: Your information is used to assess and coordinate your case, to communicate with you, and to keep a record of decisions. We do not use it for purposes unrelated to the services you requested.

sensitiveData.title: Sensitive documents
sensitiveData.body: Identity and medical documents are treated as sensitive. They are stored privately, accessed only by team members assigned to your case, and shared with partner institutions only when necessary to deliver the service you asked for.

dataSharing.title: Sharing
dataSharing.body: We share information only with the partners needed to fulfil your case — for example, a university, clinic, or travel provider — and only the details relevant to that step. We do not sell personal data.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep your information for as long as your case is active and for the period afterwards that is required by law or by our record-keeping obligations, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, subject to legal requirements. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use local storage to remember your language and theme preferences. These are functional only and are not used for advertising.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy question or request, reach us through the contact page.

termsPage.title: Terms of service
termsPage.lead: The terms that apply when you use medbourse.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using medbourse, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

services.title: The service
services.body: medbourse provides coordination for education, medical, and travel services in Türkiye. We act as an intermediary and facilitator; final admission, medical, and travel decisions rest with the relevant institutions and providers.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your account credentials secure. You must be legally able to enter into this agreement.

quotations.title: Quotations and payments
quotations.body: Where a quotation is issued, it reflects the scope described at that time and is valid as stated. Prices are shown in the currency specified and are based on a fixed snapshot; changes in scope may require a new quotation.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to misuse the service, upload unlawful or misleading content, or attempt to access data that does not belong to you.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: We take care in coordinating your case, but we are not liable for decisions made by third-party institutions or providers, or for delays and outcomes outside our control.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as the service evolves. Material changes will be reflected by the updated date above.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact page.

services.title: Three coordinated service lines
services.lead: Admissions, medical coordination, and travel support in Türkiye — handled by one team inside a single case.

education.body: Guidance on university and programme selection, application timelines, and the documents each institution expects.

medical.body: Coordination with partner clinics for consultations and treatment planning, with your records kept private.

tourism.body: Practical travel arrangements around appointments and campus visits, so each trip has a clear purpose.

contact.title: Start in your workspace
contact.body: Every enquiry runs through your own case, so documents and messages stay in one private place. Create an account below to begin, or sign in if you already have one.
